author: Jaebrosfr
quote: Bland and boring. It’s as simple as that. Story is made purely for people who don’t have jobs in real life and want to experience one, except they don’t earn money. You are basically a simp in this game, doing everything for Lucia. Personally, for a game to be considered one of the greatest of all time, it needs to be rated high on all aspects not just one. Sure, the graphics are fantastic. But the story? Horrible. Not worth it unless you want to run errands and do chores and waste your time in game!

author: Jaebrosfr
quote: One of if not the best games of all time. Beautiful music, beautiful graphics, absolutely stunning visuals. From the bottom up, this game is a masterpiece.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
